newsitem.title: USA: TransTexas commits $16.5 mln to Lobo Trend.
newsitem.headline: TransTexas commits $16.5 mln to Lobo Trend.

text.p: TransTexas Gas Corp said it has committed $16.5 million to a natural gas development drilling program on a 19,000 acre ranch that is showing unusually high production potential in the South Texas Lobo Trend.

The company said it drilled and completed a natural gas well on the B.M.T. Ranch as part of the program that includes 3-D seismic data acquisition and the drilling of 15 wells. The recently-completed B.M.T. No. 52 well is flowing at 16.1 million cubic feet of natural gas per day through a 48/64-inch choke, with flowing tubing pressure of 3,000 pounds per square inch, from a net pay interval of 45 feet. The well was drilled to a depth of 11,300 feet and completed in the Lobo 1 and Lobo 6 sands, at a cost of $1.1 million.

The company said it also intends to complete another well in the Lobo Trend, the J.C. Martin No. 15, that has encountered 53 feet of indicated electric log pay and is expected to produce at 8 million cubic feet daily.
